---
title: NADABAS technical documentation
---

NADABAS is the National Accounts Database System used to compile national
accounts statistics with Microsoft Excel, VBA, and SQL Server.

This documentation is maintained with the source code. Changes are reviewed in
GitHub pull requests and are expected to describe the versioned behaviour of
the repository.

::: {.callout-note title="Documentation foundation"}
The architecture section provides a source-verified baseline and evidence
register. The VBA internals section migrates the retained technical draft into
reviewable, source-linked pages. Environment-specific behaviour still requires
testing in supported NADABAS installations.
:::

## Start here

- [Getting started](developer-guide/getting-started.md) introduces the source
  layout and local validation workflow.
- [Export VBA](developer-guide/export-vba.md) explains how to create a complete
  text-based export from an Excel add-in.
- [Import VBA](developer-guide/import-vba.md) explains how to build a review
  add-in from the version-controlled source.
- [VBA security scanning](developer-guide/scan-vba-security.md) explains the
  scanner, severity model, and narrow approval process.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/statisticsnorway/nadabas/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
  defines the complete contribution and pull request workflow.

## Explore the system

- [Architecture](technical/architecture.qmd) describes the current system
  boundary, components, data flows, and trust boundaries.
- [VBA internals](vba/index.qmd) explains startup, Excel events, workbooks,
  database access, domain workflows, administration, and localization.
- [International review and localization](development/international-review.qmd)
  defines a traceable review protocol for multi-country and multilingual use.
- [Database](technical/database.qmd) defines the database documentation scope.
- [Excel integration](technical/excel-integration.qmd) defines the boundary
  between Excel, VBA, and external services.
- [Reference](reference/index.qmd) will provide exact, source-verified component
  and interface details.
- [Operations](operations/index.qmd) will cover administration, diagnostics,
  backup, restore, and release activities.

## Documentation roadmap

The current increment adds source-linked VBA internals and a coverage register
for the retained technical draft. Later increments will add runtime evidence,
supported-platform details, operations, and release documentation.

Incomplete material should be tracked as a GitHub issue rather than left as an
unowned placeholder in published documentation.
